fact_text: Sarmaaya describes itself as an SECP-registered digital platform that presents Pakistan Stock Exchange company financial information visually for investors.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Stop Waiting for the Dip: Sarmaaya CEO on Investing in Pakistan | How To Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-06)

fact_text: Sarmaaya's founder said the platform began in 2019 as a data portal, first run as part of his IT company, aimed at making liquid assets such as stocks and mutual funds easier to understand.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Stop Waiting for the Dip: Sarmaaya CEO on Investing in Pakistan | How To Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-06)

fact_text: Sarmaaya Pro is the company's paid service that shows a user's pension, mutual fund and stock holdings in one visual dashboard and tracks the portfolio after purchases.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Stop Waiting for the Dip: Sarmaaya CEO on Investing in Pakistan | How To Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-06)

fact_text: Sarmaaya's founder said the company was building an AI and machine-learning robo-advisory model that explains the strengths and weaknesses of a company from its data, with a launch targeted for March 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Stop Waiting for the Dip: Sarmaaya CEO on Investing in Pakistan | How To Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-06)

fact_text: The founder said market makers provide liquidity in Pakistani ETFs, so an ETF buyer or seller is not left without a counterparty, because the ETF market is still at an early stage.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Stop Waiting for the Dip: Sarmaaya CEO on Investing in Pakistan | How To Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-06)

fact_text: The founder argued that many Pakistani investors track index points rather than the value of individual holdings, and so wait for a dip that often never comes and never start investing.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Stop Waiting for the Dip: Sarmaaya CEO on Investing in Pakistan | How To Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-06)

fact_text: The founder said Pakistani retail investors are strongly influenced by news and social media, with many deciding whether to invest based on the evening news bulletins.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Stop Waiting for the Dip: Sarmaaya CEO on Investing in Pakistan | How To Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-06)
